title: DERIVED_VARIABLES — Demographics
description: Ethnic group and Ashkenazi Jewish ancestry derived from the baseline questionnaire.

R0_Ethnicity.title: Ethnicity of the study participant.
R0_Ethnicity.x-derivation: White includes: White, Jewish Ashkenazi, Jewish Sephardi. Black includes: Caribbean, African, Black-other. Asian includes: Indian, Pakistani, Bangladeshi, Chinese. Those reporting other or multiple ethnicities are grouped together.
R0_Ethnicity.$comment: Former name: ethnicity. Level 9 is the source's own 'Not known' code, kept as a level; -999 stands for the source's blank (null: 'Left blank').

R0_AshkenaziAncestry.title: Flag for whether the participant has Ashkenazi Jewish ancestry.
R0_AshkenaziAncestry.x-derivation: Binary field indicating Ashkenazi Jewish ancestry.
